answer: The orchard is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the reef. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, slashed on a failed audit, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. What survives to the dawn is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
